name: erp_credit_memo_create
description: Issue a credit memo to a customer, optionally referencing the invoice it credits (POST /services/rest/record/v1/creditMemo)

entity.description: Customer (entity) internal id receiving the credit, e.g. customer_007.

entity_name.description: Display name of the customer account.

created_from.description: Invoice tranId this memo credits (createdFrom); omit for standalone credits.

currency.description: Transaction currency internal id (currency): usd, eur or gbp.

total.description: Credit total in the transaction currency (total).
